text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, fosaprepitant dimeglumine is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation of manufacture on 2026-04-08. Corvale East holds 94 vials (11.3 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 166 vials (18.6 days on hand) of the 150 mg/5 mL presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include fosaprepitant dimeglumine as of 2026-10-21. The label for NDC 16714024801 names Aspiro Pharma Limited in India as the registered manufacturing plant, last inspected by FDA with a VAI classification on 2023-08-11.

Our position: Current inventory provides limited coverage. The rule-based best option is to purchase from AVYXA Pharma, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place. Four additional suppliers are also not on the shortage list but have unverifiable plant information.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from AVYXA Pharma, LLC; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Actavis Pharma, Inc. as secondary source; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as tertiary source; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily for status changes; requires pharmacy director approval.
5. Buyer to report inventory levels weekly to pharmacy director; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until stock reaches critical levels. Switching to alternative antiemetic regimens without P&T committee review.
